ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. THE ROLE: AMD is scaling rapidly, and our marketing organization is rebuilding how content is created, found and delivered across every channel. This role sits at the center of that change within the Digital Marketing team. Digital Asset Management (DAM) is a core, foundational technology powering this transformation: it will be the enterprise content data lake that houses every final deliverable and fuels every channel. We're looking for an engineer to connect our DAM with the entire MarTech stack. As our AI Integration Engineer, you will build the connective tissue between AMD Amplify, our enterprise digital asset management (DAM) platform powered by Orange Logic, and the ecosystems it serves: web, partner portals, sales enablement, learning, and enterprise data platforms. You will also help integrate our Taxonomy Management System (TMS): the semantic layer that ensures all systems are using consistent terminology that people and AI can both put to work. This is a hands-on build role with real ownership. You will run our integration platform as a service (iPaaS), design the Agentic flows that move assets and metadata across systems, and apply AI to concrete content problems such as tagging, enrichment, search, and the manual handoffs that slow teams down. Your work goes into production quickly and is used every day by marketing, sales, and partner teams. THE PERSON: This is not a traditional software engineering role. The ideal candidate may come from a marketing, design or content background and have moved into technical work by automating their own processes. They may also be a technologist who prefers working closely with creative and marketing teams. They use AI tools daily, including AI-assisted coding tools, and are comfortable working with APIs and low-code platforms. They learn new technologies quickly and look for chances to automate repetitive, manual work. They explain technical concepts clearly to both marketing and engineering audiences. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Build the MarTech connective tissue Own the team's iPaaS, including environments, connectors, credentials, monitoring, and the inventory of production flows. Design and build integrations that synchronize assets, metadata, versions, and lifecycle status between the DAM and connected platforms across web, partner, sales, learning, and data ecosystems. Work with REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON mappings, and build in authentication, error handling, retries, and logging so integrations run reliably at scale. Write Python or JavaScript utilities for API interactions, bulk metadata operations, data validation, and reconciliation across systems. AI at Enterprise Scale Connect large language model services and AI agents to DAM workflows through APIs and the iPaaS, with human review where accuracy or brand risk calls for it. Help build the semantic layer across our content: the structured metadata, relationships, and context that make assets discoverable and usable by both people and AI. Define evaluation methods and quality thresholds, measure results, and keep improving what ships. Automate how marketing works Map content workflows from creation through distribution, find the manual handoffs, and design automations that remove them. Partner with taxonomy, platform, and operations teammates so automations follow AMD content standards and governance. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience in integration engineering, automation, marketing technology, solutions engineering, or enterprise application implementation, with solutions running in production. Hands-on experience building and maintaining workflows on an iPaaS or automation platform such as OneTeg, Workato, Tray.ai, Zapier, Boomi, MuleSoft, Make, or Microsoft Power Automate. Platform certification is a plus. Working knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and authentication methods such as OAuth 2.0 and API keys, using Postman or similar tools. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript, working knowledge of SQL, and comfort with Git. Hands-on experience using large language model services or AI tools in real workflows, including prompt design and judging output quality. Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, AI agents, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus. Understanding of common AI failure modes, such as hallucination and prompt injection, and how to design safeguards around them. Experience with digital asset management, content management, or product information platforms such as Orange Logic, Adobe Experience Manager, Aprimo, Widen, SiteCore, Sharedien, Censhare, or Bynder, and an understanding of metadata, taxonomies, and controlled vocabularies, are a plus. Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners, and experience working on Agile or Scrum teams. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience with demonstrated integration and automation impact. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. #LI-CJ2 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD’s “Responsible AI Policy” is available here. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
